description: Download every record of a dataset API (up to 3,000) as JSON in one go. Offered on datasets with more than 50 records; priced like a call returning that many records (see options.full_export), paid from the key's credit. Without enough credit it returns the price and how to pay (x402 at full_export_url, or add credit).
name: export_dataset
title: Export a whole dataset
